name: Flicker Strike Slayer
summary: Flicker Strike on the Slayer shell. The build spends frenzy charges to teleport-strike through a pack, and Blood Rage plus Slayer leech keep the charges and life coming back. No required unique.

pros.text: Flicker Strike teleports to enemies, so clear is fast and hands-off.
No required unique; a rare two-handed axe carries the damage.
Slayer leech and culling make the boss fight forgiving.
Blood Rage supplies frenzy charges between packs.
The same armour and axe bases as the other melee builds.

cons.text: Flicker teleports you into danger; positioning is not fully yours.
Frenzy charge downtime stops the build.
Clear speed depends on keeping the chain going.
Melee range means you eat mechanics.
Mana is tight before leech and reduced cost are solved.
A six-link is a large damage step.

pantheon.note: Gruthkul reduces physical damage taken, which is most of what kills a flicker build.

notes: First guide for the Covens league.

summary.text: Flicker Strike Slayer is a fast melee build that measures 422.4k at red maps and 731.7k at pinnacle. Blood Rage and Slayer leech keep the frenzy chain alive, and no unique is required.

leveling.text: Level with Double Strike until Flicker Strike and Blood Rage are available. The first checkpoint measures 382 life and 115 damage; the second measures 520.

maps.text: At red maps the build measures 422.4k damage, 19863 effective life and 9185 physical max hit. Keep Blood Rage up, cap the resistances, and let the filter hide the rest.

bossing.text: Pinnacle measures 731.7k damage with 28387 effective life and 11638 physical max hit. Keep a frenzy source for the boss and use the Slayer leech window instead of standing still.
